## Summary

Accept explicitly approved distilled facts, decisions, and receipts derived from conversations while refusing raw transcript payloads.

**Workstream key:** `SOURCE-4`  
**Priority:** P2  
**Parent:** #336  
**Depends on:** #337

## Scope

- Define a distilled conversation-derived item contract.
- Require explicit approval and exact scope.
- Reject or strip raw transcript structures.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Only explicitly approved distilled items are stored.
- [ ] Raw transcript bodies and bulk turn dumps are refused.
- [ ] Every accepted item carries a source reference and exact namespace and scope.

## Validation

- [ ] Test accepted distilled facts and decisions.
- [ ] Test rejection of raw transcript and multi-turn dump payloads.
- [ ] Run cross-namespace write isolation tests.

## Non-goals

- Capturing conversations without approval.
- Automatically tuning conversation distillation quality.

## Standing constraints

- Exact namespace and session-scope isolation remains a security boundary.
- Prompt placement stays client/runtime-owned; no implicit MCP `_meta` injection.
- Observability remains content-free.
- Dream planning remains dry-run-safe unless a separately authorized mutating wrapper is used.
